newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Police fear for kidnapped Australian woman.
newsitem.headline: Police fear for kidnapped Australian woman.

text.p: Australian police said on Wednesday they held grave fears for the safety of a wealthy Sydney woman kidnapped 15 days ago because her abductors had broken off contact after making several ransom demands.
Kerry Whelan, 39, the wife of a millionare businessman, was last seen leaving her car in an underground carpark in the western Sydney suburb of Parramatta on May 6.
Whelan was wearing several gold and diamond rings and bracelets, including one bracelet boasting 20 diamonds.

"Police and the victim's husband hold grave fears for her safety as the deadline for the abductors' ransom demands has expired and communications with those responsible has ceased," Detective Inspector Mick Howe told a news conference.
Police said the kidnappers had demanded a "substantial sum of money" for her release.
Whelan's abduction had previously been kept secret.
